notes: Every matching source line is retained, including comments and metadata; site count is not a count of debit implementations.
Actual debit implementations: OperationEngine._advance, CruxEngine._advance, WorkflowNestingEngine._advance. All other engines delegate through these.

Route-bearing jobs pay recall_units, then each route hop and one content unit, then material_units. Stored content_units is one seat unit in current code; varying content/syntax sizes live in recall_units and are not seat-priced.

Selection/admission comparisons, read/delivery work, recall, syntax and material work stay equal currency. Existing time-priced selector affordability policy remains; grade-v1 must not optimize route or support choice.
Schedulers and raw exhaustion auditors assume a zero minimum wallet; grade-v1 must also handle insufficient positive energy at step admission and continuation after prepaid energy reaches zero.
spent/completed remain cumulative time, including receipts and child cost summaries. They are not renamed as energy.
